sharedPrompt: Generate ONE sophisticated, realistic SOFTWARE INTERFACE PRESENTATION, landscape 3:2, for an engineer's portfolio. Use the supplied actual app screenshot as the project reference. The output itself must BE the clean application interface, edge to edge: no monitor, no laptop, no phone, no tablet, no hardware bezel, no device frame, no browser chrome, no desktop OS frame, no keyboard, no photography, no room, no desk, no plants, no environmental mockup, no perspective tilt. Completely flat straight-on pixel-perfect product design. Professional restrained real-world SaaS interface, strong grid, balanced whitespace, crisp legible typography, nuanced thin borders and very soft shadows. Do not add marketing copy outside the interface. No science-fiction, neon, holograms, giant decorative 3D objects, abstract AI art, pointless gradients, cartoon mascots, or nonsense text. Real functional UI arranged with editorial taste, not a generic pile of dashboard widgets. Readable central content at thumbnail size. Outer composition fills every pixel with the application surface.

projects.prompt: XAI-PE Analyzer. Sophisticated charcoal/navy cybersecurity analysis application, small restrained cobalt accents, top horizontal header with exact name XAI-PE Analyzer. Main left panel to upload a PE file with simple outline upload icon and text Drop PE file here and Scan file button. Right concise analysis panel for notepad.exe with a subtle green Benign badge, compact file information and a restrained horizontal feature-contribution chart labeled Feature analysis. Use only real capabilities: file analysis and explainability. No invented accuracy claims. Improve the reference typography and spacing; no neon glows. Flat UI screen filling the whole image.

DARKLACE / Meeting assistant. Restrained near-black desktop application content, refined neutral typography, very subtle lilac accent, a small real audio waveform next to Listening indicator at top. Two-column main area: left live transcript labeled Live transcript with three short legible meeting notes; right Assistant response card with a concise useful answer. Bottom full-width prompt bar Ask about this conversation. Minimal purposeful interface, no people, avatars, robots or microphones as decorative illustrations. Keep name DARKLACE and the meeting-assistant functionality from reference. Flat interface edge-to-edge without any frame.

Ultra Dim brightness application. Completely frameless wide application surface, NOT a phone screenshot: near-black background, polished large brightness control across center, clear 40% number, one elegant horizontal slider with green accent. Two restrained preset cards Night and Normal, a concise Ultra Dim Overlay switch row below. Exact small wordmark Ultra Dim at upper left. Visually calm, accessible, usable brightness utility. Little crescent and sun line icons only as functional controls, no 3D moons. No permission-error or debug labels. Recompose the reference into a balanced landscape interface, no device frames.

UNIMAS AR Navigator. Flat beautifully restrained light campus navigation application, warm off-white canvas, dark slate typography and a muted blue accent. Left sidebar with UNIMAS AR Navigator heading, concise Campus navigation subheading, two selectable rows Campus overview and AR navigation, primary Begin AR Experience button. Main area an understated schematic 2D campus-map visualization: simple architectural footprints in pale gray, small muted-green landscape patches, a thin blue route and a few purposeful location pins, no precise invented geographic labels. This is a product-interface concept based on the app, not evidence of a real campus route. No perspective rendering, no smartphone, no outdoor photograph, no giant crest, no photo of buildings. Broad whitespace, sophisticated cartographic graphic quality.

FileConvert. Beautiful restrained professional white/light gray file-conversion web app filling the entire image, no browser border. Exact FileConvert wordmark at top left, short large heading Convert files. Simply. Main wide upload dropzone with simple blue upload line icon and Drop files here, blue Choose files button. Lower a tidy horizontal conversion queue showing photo.png to WebP, document.docx to PDF, video.mov to MP4 with small unobtrusive file-type icons and status Ready. Bottom four simple compact categories Documents, Images, Video, Audio. Align everything carefully, generous margin, crisp blue and graphite. No floating files, no desktop or physical devices. A credible useful utility matching the reference features.
